text: זֵכֶר יְלִיד נוּן. וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אוּרִי אֶפְנוּן. יִזָּכְרוּ בְּרִנּוּן. פִּלְאָם לִזְכּוֹר: יֶקֶשׁ בְּרַק הַשָּׁנוּן. אִם הָשְׁלַף לְתַאֲנוּן. יַקְשִׁיב תַּחֲנוּן. חֲנוּנָיו לִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר טַעַם שֹׁפְטִים. וְאוֹת קְצִיר חִטִּים. טֶפֶשׁ שׁוֹטִים. יְחַתֵּל מִלִּזְכּוֹר: טֹרַח אַרְבַּעַת שְׁפָטִים. אִם נֶעֶנְשׁוּ נִשְׁפָּטִים. טֶבַע מִשְׁפָּטִים. אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה. וְתוֹדוֹת מִשְׁפְּטֵי לַיְלָה. חֹשֶׁךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה. נִגּוּנוֹ לָמוֹ יִזְכּוֹר: חֵקֶר מִפְקַד לַיְלָה. יַגִּיהַּ בְּלַהַב לַיְלָה. חֹק הֶגֶה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. לְגִיהָם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר זֶה זְבוּל. אֲשֶׁר בְּבִצְעִי חָבוּל. זְדוֹנוֹת סָבוּל. עוֹד בַּל יִזְכּוֹר: זַעַם כַּמַּבּוּל. אִם יָצְאָה לְחַבּוּל. זִכְרֹן יֶרַח בּוּל. לְחֶמְלָה יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר וְכַח

text: He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured. He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them. May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf. May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing. He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins.
